name: REVEREND SOWERBY
note: SOWERBY AT THE GATE (doc 57 C3 and D4: on the funeral day, if Sheng's task is set, 'Sowerby is at the gate with the plate'). His funeral sheet, cut from room-31's master and lit by the same moon on the same hill (tools/art/room31-night.py); no sheet of him holds the plate, so the plate is in the direction, not the picture -- for Tyler's playthrough. He is there for the visit that ends the day, and back in his church after. Errata 246 (doc 115 II-1): the plate is drawn now. While it is in Thad's hands his hand is on its rim, and once it is his again he holds it (spriteWhen; act2-papers operation 3, turned to the line by tools/art/act2-collection-sheet.py).
barksNote: He is spoken to through doc 115's THE REVEREND, AT THE GATE.
